experiment_data.hypothesis: Pure collapse (r=0, 100% synthetic) with seed 43 reproduces the three-phase spectral trajectory (decompression Gen 0-2, onset Gen 2-4, collapse Gen 4-10) observed in exp_001 (seed 42). This validates C1 claim that the spectral collapse pattern is reproducible across random seeds, not an artifact of a single training run.
